entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What!? You're...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: K-Kamoshida!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Sens—

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: No... Madarame...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Kaneshiro's over here.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Is President Okumura here too!?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Father isn't around anymore...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...Sorry.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: No, it's okay. More importantly, look there.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Masayoshi Shido!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The hell's goin' on!? These guys shoulda[n]had a change of heart from their Palaces[n]disappearin'!

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: Mm, your bod's as great as always.[n]C'mon, come closer.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You creep!

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: Hmph... I'm joking. I don't want any more[n]trouble.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: I finally get to live without having to think[n]for myself now.

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: I mistakenly thought myself to be[n]talented... but now I think I'm a fool[n]for wanting too much.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: It's no wonder people who can't take a[n]hint get yelled at...

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: I'm done actin' like a big shot. Who cares[n]if I'm stupid?

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: It's not like you get punished for bein'[n]dumb. Nobody needs to strive to be[n]more than they really are.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: These people seem completely different[n]than they were before...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I don't think it's because they had a[n]change of heart though...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Wait... Have they chosen a life of captivity[n]after they lost their distorted desires?

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: Unfortunately, Okumura isn't here with us.

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: Nothing can be done for the dead...[n]I'm sorry.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: ...Yes, I know. Thank you for the details.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Now if you don't mind, what in the world[n]is this place?

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: It's supposedly called the "Prison of[n]Regression."

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Regression?

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: More importantly, does this look like[n]captivity to you?

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: Why, it's the exact opposite. The utmost[n]freedom is available to anyone who[n]desires it here.

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: This is the freedom to not make[n]decisions... The release from having[n]to think for yourself.

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: It is far more marvelous than the country[n]I wished to create...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Release from having to think? But, that's...

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: However, there are some fools who[n]cannot stay put in this place.

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: In other words, they are escaped[n]convicts... Of course, I'm talking[n]about our past selves.

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: Such people are segregated from this[n]peaceful world and locked away in their[n]own Palaces.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So those are the Palace rulers...

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: I really gotta thank you for changin' my[n]heart. I got to come back here, after all.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We... sent 'em back here?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I don't understand...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Just what have we been doing by using[n]the cognitive world?
Reforming society.
It's too late to ask that now.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Get a hold of yourself, Inari!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Yes, you're right... I'm sorry...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: We saved people. We saved each other[n]too, didn't we?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Y-You're right... I'm sorry...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That's true, but...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: This ain't the time to be gettin' confused!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We're here as the society-fixin' Phantom[n]Thieves today!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Having the freedom to not make your own[n]decisions only means that someone else is[n]controlling you!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Tell me—who is the ruler here? Who made[n]all of this?

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: What an odd question to ask. It should[n]be obvious: every member of the general[n]public.

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: Haven't you learned anything in school?[n]The collective ruler of a democratic[n]country is its people.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: D-Don't lie outta your ass like that!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I mean, there was a guard here earlier![n]That means someone's gotta be lookin'[n]out for you guys, right?

entries.speaker: Shadow Shido
entries.en: You may be right. We are the ones[n]"looking out" upon everyone else.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So the ones who least want the prison[n]to be tampered with... are the prisoners[n]themselves?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It don't matter what this guy's talkin'[n]about...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We're gonna erase all of Mementos[n]anyways! C'mon, let's get goin'!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Mona! The Treasure's in the deepest part,[n]right!?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Mona?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I do remember this place...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I saw the humans in here... and realized[n]I looked different than them for some[n]reason...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Right! That's when I started to think[n]I wanted to turn into a human!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Is that why you thought you would[n]regain your true form if we destroyed[n]Mementos?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Sorry... I'm still missing a lot of my[n]memories...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But I know I started randomly checking[n]a bunch of Palaces...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Then my next memory is about that[n]bastard Kamoshida's.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Yeah. I'm starting to remember more...

entries.speaker: Guard Captain
entries.en: What are you doing here?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Guards again!? And there are more of[n]them this time!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Dammit... We got careless!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Let's run!

entries.speaker: Guard Captain
entries.en: I've discovered some escaped inmates![n]Catch them at once!
